item.title: Good morning, Naresh, and happy Thursday, September 17th, 2026! It's a crisp 11°...
item.description: Good morning, Naresh, and happy Thursday, September 17th, 2026! It's a crisp 11°C with overcast skies here in Sydney as we kick off our Daily Drive. Today's a fresh canvas, a chance to paint your day with purpose and positivity, and with no rain on the cards, you can leave that umbrella behind! Remember, a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step, so let's make that first step count and have an absolutely brilliant day!
